roleContext.roleTitle: Senior Project Manager, Airport Baggage Systems
roleContext.jobDescription: The airport baggage systems business installs and upgrades baggage handling systems under fixed-price contracts with airport operators. The Senior Project Manager is the project manager of record on installation projects: signs the project charter and the contractual milestone certificates, holds the project budget under the business's delegated limits, runs the night-time cut-overs with the airport operator, and directs the site project engineers. Prior experience as project manager of record on airport or comparable live-operations installations is required, together with the PMP or an equivalent recognised project management credential. Reports to the head of projects; works with the airport operators, the site teams and the commercial team.

requirements.text: Has been the project manager of record on airport or comparable live-operations installations, signing the charter and the milestone certificates.
Holds the PMP or an equivalent recognised project management credential.
Holds the project budget under the business's delegated limits.
Runs cut-overs with the operator and directs the site project engineers under a documented cut-over method.
Documents project boundaries, risks and hand-over conditions at each milestone.

candidate.originalCvMarkdown:
# Curriculum vitae

Target role: Senior Project Manager, Airport Baggage Systems

## Experience

- Senior Project Manager and project manager of record on three airport baggage system installations for a systems integrator between 2020 and 2025, signing the project charters and the contractual milestone certificates for each; before that, three years as a site project engineer on two installations.
- PMP credential held since 2019 and current; credential number and the institute's registry entry available for verification.
- Held the project budget for each installation under the business's delegated limits, with the monthly cost reports to the head of projects filed in the project folders.
- Ran the night-time cut-overs with the airport operators under the business's cut-over method, directing the site project engineers through the cut-over plan and the fallback checklist at each of the three sites.
- Wrote the project boundary statement, the risk register and the hand-over conditions submitted with each milestone certificate.

## Work samples

- Work sample: one signed project charter, two signed milestone certificates, one cut-over plan with its fallback checklist and the credential certificate, with the project folder references as a verification trail.
